user.title: Gateway connection

data.host: Gateway (pre-filled from the scan when one is detected)
data.rescan: Scan again: tick this, then press Submit (setup will not continue)

mode.title: Read-only or read-write?
mode.description:
**Read-only (recommended first):** reads your inverter and shows, on the device page, exactly what the schedule WOULD change. Nothing is ever written. Use this to check the plan against your tariff before trusting it.

**Read-write:** every 10 minutes the integration changes your inverter's AC-charge windows, AC First windows, charge limits and AC charge power to match the plan. You can switch between the two later with the 'Read-only mode' switch.

confirm.title: Confirm read-write
confirm.description: This will modify settings on your inverter. Make sure no other automation or tool is writing the same registers (AC charge windows, AC First windows, AC charge start/end SOC, AC charge power). There is no warranty.

data.understood: I understand and want to enable writes

tariff.title: Time-of-use tariff
tariff.description:
Pick a ready-made tariff, or define your own peak hours.

The 12000XP can hold the battery (so the grid carries the house) around **up to 2 on-peak windows per day** per schedule. Custom schedules let you enter 1 or 2 windows for each season. Charging happens overnight and the battery is spent only inside the peak windows.

Holidays: the BGE preset uses the holiday list printed in BGE's tariff. For custom schedules, public holidays come from the country and state you entered, which can include days your utility bills as normal weekdays; untick the holiday box if yours does.

data.offpeak_weekends: Treat Saturdays and Sundays as all off-peak
data.offpeak_holidays: Treat public holidays as off-peak (custom schedules only)

summer_dates.title: When is summer?
summer_dates.description: Enter the first and last day of your **summer** rate season. Every other day is treated as winter.

single_kind.title: Which charge limit applies?
single_kind.description: A single all-year schedule still uses one of the two weekday charge limits (you can change the limits afterwards).

peak.title: On-peak window {n} of up to {max} ({season})
peak.description: Enter the weekday on-peak hours for **{season}** (the start must be before the end, on the same day). Tick 'Add a second window' if there is another peak later in the day, for example a morning and an evening peak.

reconfigure.title: Change gateway or holiday region
reconfigure.description: Change the gateway's address, port or unit id, or the country and state used for public holidays. Your tariff, mode and charge settings are kept. The new gateway is checked with a read-only probe before anything is saved.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the inverter through that gateway.
error.must_confirm: Tick the box to enable read-write, or go back and choose read-only.
error.bad_date: That is not a valid date.
error.season_full_year: Summer cannot cover the whole year. Use 'one schedule all year' instead.
error.peak_order: The peak must end after it starts, on the same day. Midnight-crossing peaks: split them into two windows.
error.too_many_peaks: The 12000XP supports at most 2 on-peak windows per day.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or a host name (letters, digits, dots and hyphens).
error.public_address: That is a public internet address. Modbus has no authentication, so the gateway must be on your local network: use its local (private) address.
error.bad_country: Unknown country code. Use the two-letter code, for example US or CA.
error.bad_subdiv: Unknown state/region for that country. Use its code (for example MD), or leave it empty.
error.already_configured: Another EG4 TOU entry already uses that gateway.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Saved. The integration has been reloaded with the new settings.
